extra.reason: App idea decided: Penultimate I - The Ring
Superseded by core domain-model bead (nextjs-fullstack-starter-nwe.3)

Architecture decided + documented in game/ARCHITECTURE.md: Canvas 2D tile engine, ~11x11 viewport, discrete event-driven movement, pure DOM-free core + browser adapters, fits notes/Server-Action pattern.
docs/ATTRIBUTION.md created: OSM ODbL, VBB/BVG license TODO, original-art/IP stance + asset registry.
Engine scaffold complete: game/ pure core (types/world/state/input/systems/movement) + browser adapters (canvasRenderer/controller) + barrel. tsc --noEmit clean.

Domain model migrated. Added World/TileMap/District/Location/Player/Party/Character/Gear/CharacterGear/PlayerSession (+enums). Also fixed starter's Prisma 7 wiring: pg driver adapter, prisma.config.ts, url out of datasource. Migration 20260805135112_init_game_domain applied; tsc clean.

world/ring-boundary.geojson: valid closed polygon (~80 km2, bbox 13.284-13.475E / 52.477-52.559N). APPROXIMATION (no network in subagent sandbox); real S41/S42 OSM geometry to be supplied by osm-extract (3rx.2).

/play route built: app/play/page.tsx (start screen) + app/play/game-canvas.tsx (client) mounting CanvasRenderer+GameController, window keydown movement, Ultima-style HUD (party/messages/legend). tsc clean; dev server returns HTTP 200 with canvas + HUD rendered.
world/lib/projection.mjs: local equirectangular, ring bbox -> 324x229 @ 40m/tile; project/unproject/pointInPolygon/insideRing. Verified: Brandenburg Gate -> (158,118).
OSM terrain fetched via Overpass (curl; node fetch hit a dead mirror). world/build/fetch-osm.mjs + world/osm/terrain.json (12849 elements, ODbL). Venues extraction is separate (3rx.6).
world/build/build-overworld.mjs rasterizes water/parks onto walkable street base, clips outside-Ring to rail. Counts: 38009 street / 8161 park / 4223 water / 23803 rail.

Viewport-following CanvasRenderer renders the real overworld (verified). Scope complete on placeholder colors; the ua1.1->nwe.4 link was a mis-estimate (sprites are ua1.2/nwe.4, not needed to render). --force past that stale blocker.

90 Berlin Ortsteil/quarter labels from OSM; every inside-Ring tile assigned its nearest district (Voronoi). Baked into asset as districts[] + districtGrid; loader sets Tile.district; HUD shows current district. world/build/build-places.mjs.

600 venues placed from OSM on walkable tiles, capped+spatially spread, categorized -> BAR/RESTAURANT/GROCERY/SPAETI/CLOTHING/SPORT/ARMOURY/NIGHTCLUB (103 clubs). Rendered as venue tiles; HUD names the venue you stand on. fetch-places.mjs + build-places.mjs.
Keyboard movement + collision complete (step() + isPassable, event-driven), verified in /play and via tests.
Interior sub-map format: small GameMaps reusing the tile renderer; walls=building, floor=plaza, door=venue. game/systems/interior.ts buildInterior().

Enter-location works: press Enter on a venue -> enterInterior (remembers overworld return), step on door/press Enter -> exitInterior. Unit-tested. --force past ua1.4 (load-world functionally done; only its DB-seed tail via 3rx.7 remains).
Generic interior template: category-flavored rooms (bar counter, shop shelves, nightclub pillars), enter/exit round-trip, HUD shows 'Inside: <venue>'. tests/interior.test.ts green.

Shop scaffold: per-category catalogs (grocery/späti/clothing/sport/armoury/bar/restaurant), buy/sell over party gold+pack (game/systems/shop.ts, pure). HUD shop panel with Buy/Sell buttons; keyguard so buttons don't trigger exit. Added minimal RPG runtime slice (Party.gold+inventory) that qb2.1 will formalize. tests/shop.test.ts (3) green. --force past qb2.1.

Character model (game/systems/party.ts + types): race, class, level, HP/maxHP, stats (str/dex/int/wis), equipment slots (weapon/armor/shield). Derived characterAttack/characterDefense. Party.members roster. Unit-tested.
Gear given combat stats: shop weapons carry attack, armor carries defense (game/systems/shop.ts); carried through buy -> pack -> equip. Equipping updates derived ATK/DEF. Tested.

Default starting party (4 archetypes) via createDefaultParty; HUD roster with HP bars, ATK/DEF, select-a-member, equip/unequip gear. NOTE: custom creation UI (choose race/class, roll stats) left as a future enhancement.

Combat design: turn-based 11x11 arena, party acts one member at a time (move or attack adjacent), then monster AI turns; deterministic damage = max(1, ATK-DEF) using characterAttack/Defense; win=loot, wipe=revive+gold penalty, flee. game/systems/combat.ts.

Monster roster + terrain encounter tables (game/systems/monsters.ts): Drug Addict, Thief, Wild Boar + exotic Neon Wraith/U-Bahn Troll/Rave Specter; weighted by street/park; rollEncounter(rng) 1-3 foes.

Playable tile combat: ~10% encounter on street/park steps -> arena; controller combat input (arrows attack/move, F flee); renderer combat view (combatants + active highlight); HUD combat panel. HP writes back to party; 4 unit tests green.
Asset pipeline: original 8x8 pixel patterns (game/renderer/tiles.ts) pre-baked to a per-tileSize atlas of offscreen canvases in CanvasRenderer; drawImage blit with flat-color SSR fallback.
Original overworld pixel tiles: water/park/street/building/rail/venue + hero sprite. Rendered in /play; validated by tests/tiles.test.ts and a PNG preview. No copyrighted assets.
Interior pixel tiles covered by the same set (plaza wood floor, building walls, venue door) since interiors reuse tile kinds; foe sprite for combat.
World bundle complete + DB seeded: prisma/seed-world.ts (npm run db:seed:world) upserts World + 90 Districts and creates 600 Locations (linked to districts via districtGrid). Verified counts.
Load-world complete: engine loads public/world/berlin-overworld.json into /play (terrain+districts+venues render, verified); DB now seeded from the same asset.

Save/load via Server Actions (app/play/actions.ts): saveParty/loadParty persist party (position/gold in columns, members+inventory in Party.flags JSON) to a single local slot; /play auto-loads on start + Save button. DB round-trip verified (save + update). tsc + 17 tests green.

XP & leveling: monsters carry xp; resolveCombat grants total XP to surviving members; grantXp/xpForNextLevel (level*100 curve) level up = +6 maxHP, +1 class primary stat, full heal (game/systems/party.ts). HUD shows Lv + XP/next; persists via save (members JSON). tsc + 21 tests green (4 new).

Custom character creation complete: /play/create lets you name 4 members, pick race + class, and point-buy stats (24-point pool); makeCharacter builds level-1 chars with class HP. Reuses saveParty (sentinel position) -> /play spawns the new party at world start. Default party still available. tsc + 24 tests green (3 new).

Design: server-side Claude dialogue. Model default claude-opus-4-8 (swap const to claude-haiku-4-5 for cheap/fast); thinking disabled + tight persona prompt for short in-character replies; key in process.env server-side; history capped to 6 turns, message/inputs length-capped.
NPC persona model (game/systems/npc.ts, pure): per-category role+trait, deterministic keeper name, server-authored system prompt (client can't dictate it). Unit-tested.

Thin slice: talk to a venue's keeper. app/play/npc-actions.ts (use server) npcReply via @anthropic-ai/sdk; /play dialogue panel (input/log, key-guarded so typing doesn't move the party). Graceful fallback with no API key. tsc + 27 tests green.

Transit data: 121 U-/S-Bahn stations inside the Ring from OSM (ODbL) via Overpass. world/build/fetch-transit.mjs -> world/osm/transit.json. Used OSM station geometry rather than VBB GTFS (same license family, drops into existing pipeline); noted in docs/ATTRIBUTION.md TODO.

Transit model: new 'station' TileKind (pixel tile + color + passable) + asset.stations [{id,name,x,y,kind U/S}]. build-transit.mjs projects/dedupes/places stations on walkable tiles; loader decodes 's'; stationList/stationMap helpers. 78 U + 43 S placed.

Fast-travel: stand on a station -> HUD Travel panel lists every other station; Ride -> controller.travelTo teleports the party (logs the trip). Exceeds the two-station stub (all 121). tsc + 29 tests green (2 new transit).

Design documented in docs/MULTIPLAYER.md: shared World; Player linked to NextAuth by email (local fallback); Party is the per-(player,world) save; PlayerSession = presence; realtime deferred (reads/writes existing presence fields, no schema change).

Multiplayer-ready schema: Player.image; Party @@unique([playerId,worldId]); PlayerSession presence (mapId/tileX/tileY) + @@unique. Migration 20260806130000_multiplayer_ownership applied. actions.ts now resolves player via auth() (email) with local fallback, upserts party by composite + writes presence. DB round-trip verified (save+update); tsc + 29 tests green.

DECIDED (2026-08-06): hybrid single-level dungeon. Night clubs generate one dark maze interior with placed/random exotic-monster encounters + a boss, reusing the interior + tile-combat systems (not multi-level, not HUD-only terrain). Un-deferred.

Night-club dungeon (hybrid single level): entering a NIGHTCLUB builds a 15x13 maze interior (game/systems/interior.ts buildClubDungeon) with a door + boss marker; walking triggers exotic encounters (clubEncounter), the boss tile fights the Techno Titan (clubBoss); victory clears it + drops a Neon Blade. Also decoupled combat's return slot from the interior's so a fight nests inside the dungeon (fixed a latent overworld-return bug). tsc + 33 tests green (4 new).
